$comment: pipelinq's escalation queues in the Zuiddrecht set (cti-escalation-queues): board PqGesprekAfronden closes a call as Escalated and hands it to "Vergunningen, tweede lijn". A queue is app config `cti_escalation_queues` ({ id, label, groupId }); the follow-up task is assigned to the queue's group. The groups are the second-line teams; their members are set by the people who staff them.
